title: ConfigPathOutput
description: The envelope `duckduckgo-search-cli config path` writes on stdout. Added in v1.0.3 (GAP-SCHEMA-INTROSPECTION-UNDECLARED-001) — found by sweeping the whole `config` family after closing `config list`, which is what turned one undeclared envelope into five. v1.0.4 added the `type` discriminator: the whole family emitted none, so the published catalog could not route any of it and a consumer had to identify each of the five by the subcommand it happened to invoke — which is not something a document carries. English-only: configuration paths are part of the CLI contract.

type.description: Envelope discriminator (v1.0.4+). Emitted by `types::ConfigKind::ConfigPath`, a compiler-checked constant rather than a hand-typed literal.

config_directory.description: Resolved XDG / Application Support / APPDATA directory, or `--config-home` verbatim. Reported even when it does not exist yet.

config_file.description: Absolute path of `config.toml` inside that directory. Reported even when absent, so the caller learns where a `config set` would write.
